role.en: Associate Dean & Chair Professor of Generative AI, Hong Kong PolyU; Executive Director, PolyU Academy for AI
role.zh: 香港理工大学计算及数学科学学院副院长、生成式人工智能讲座教授；PolyU AI 研究院执行主任

why.en: Former technical lead of Alibaba's M6 and ByteDance's large models, she drove one of China's earliest trillion-parameter multimodal systems — an early practitioner of ultra-large multimodal training.
why.zh: 前阿里 M6 与字节大模型技术负责人，主导了中国最早的万亿参数多模态模型之一，是国内超大规模多模态训练的早期实践者。

title.en: M6: a Chinese multimodal pretrainer at trillion-parameter scale
title.zh: M6：万亿参数规模的中文多模态预训练模型

note.en: One of China's earliest trillion-parameter multimodal systems.
note.zh: 中国最早的万亿参数多模态系统之一。

title.en: Evaluating Counterfactual Sensitivity to Patient Information in Medication-Safety Reasoning
title.zh: Evaluating Counterfactual Sensitivity to Patient Information in Medication-Safety Reasoning

note.en: Her group's benchmark testing whether medical LLMs actually condition medication-safety rules on patient-specific details rather than applying them blindly.
note.zh: 她团队提出的评测方法，检验医疗大模型在用药安全推理时是否真正结合了患者的个体信息，而不是机械套用规则。

title.en: Beyond Captions: Context-Grounded Reconstruction for Biomedical Multimodal Continued Pretraining
title.zh: Beyond Captions: Context-Grounded Reconstruction for Biomedical Multimodal Continued Pretraining

note.en: A biomedical multimodal pretraining method that grounds figures in the surrounding body text instead of captions alone.
note.zh: 一种生物医学多模态继续预训练方法，用正文上下文而非仅靠图注来理解图像。

title.en: Access Sets Matter: Budgeting Expert Reads for Scalable Weight-Space Model Merging
title.zh: Access Sets Matter: Budgeting Expert Reads for Scalable Weight-Space Model Merging

note.en: Treats LLM model merging as a budgeted problem over how many expert checkpoints must be read, part of her lab's ongoing model-merging line.
note.zh: 把大模型合并看作“读取多少专家权重”的预算问题，属于她实验室持续推进的模型合并方向。

title.en: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation
title.zh: Not All Disagreement Is Learnable: Token Teachability in On-Policy Distillation

note.en: Studies which teacher-student token disagreements are actually learnable in on-policy distillation.
note.zh: 研究在同策略蒸馏中，师生之间哪些 token 级别的分歧才是真正可学的。

title.en: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
title.zh: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond

note.en: A method for extreme KV-cache quantization to cut the memory bottleneck in long-context and multimodal inference.
note.zh: 一种极低比特 KV Cache 量化方法，用于缓解长上下文与多模态推理的显存瓶颈。

title.en: E-PMQ: Expert-Guided Post-Merge Quantization with Merged-Weight Anchoring
title.zh: E-PMQ: Expert-Guided Post-Merge Quantization with Merged-Weight Anchoring

note.en: Combines model merging with post-training quantization by anchoring quantization to the merged weights.
note.zh: 将模型合并与训练后量化结合，以合并后的权重为锚进行量化。

title.en: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models
title.zh: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models

note.en: Calibrates features of merged models to recover the accuracy that merging loses relative to individual task experts.
note.zh: 通过特征校准弥补合并模型相对单一任务专家模型的性能损失。

title.en: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training
title.zh: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training

note.en: Explains catastrophic forgetting in LLM continual post-training as a geometric conflict between sequential updates.
note.zh: 从几何冲突的角度解释大模型持续后训练中的遗忘问题，并给出控制方法。

title.en: Attention Sink in Transformers: A Survey on Utilization, Interpretation, and Mitigation
title.zh: Attention Sink in Transformers: A Survey on Utilization, Interpretation, and Mitigation

note.en: A survey of the attention-sink phenomenon in Transformers, covering how it is used, interpreted and mitigated.
note.zh: 关于 Transformer 中 attention sink 现象的综述，梳理其利用、解释与缓解方法。

title.en: InfiCoEvalChain: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized Framework for Collaborative LLM Evaluation
title.zh: InfiCoEvalChain: A Blockchain-Based Decentralized Framework for Collaborative LLM Evaluation

note.en: A decentralized, blockchain-based framework for collaborative LLM evaluation, matching her public argument for decentralizing large models.
note.zh: 基于区块链的去中心化大模型协同评测框架，与她公开主张的“大模型走向去中心化”一脉相承。

title.en: MergePipe: A Budget-Aware Parameter Management System for Scalable LLM Merging
title.zh: MergePipe: A Budget-Aware Parameter Management System for Scalable LLM Merging

note.en: A budget-aware parameter management system that makes large-scale LLM merging practical as an engineering pipeline.
note.zh: 面向预算的参数管理系统，让大规模大模型合并在工程流水线中可用。

title.en: BPDQ: Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization on a Variable Grid for Large Language Models
title.zh: BPDQ: Bit-Plane Decomposition Quantization on a Variable Grid for Large Language Models

note.en: A post-training quantization scheme using bit-plane decomposition on a variable grid for memory-constrained LLM serving.
note.zh: 一种基于可变网格位平面分解的训练后量化方案，面向显存受限的大模型部署。

title.en: Canonical Intermediate Representation for LLM-based optimization problem formulation and code generation
title.zh: Canonical Intermediate Representation for LLM-based optimization problem formulation and code generation

note.en: Uses a canonical intermediate representation so LLMs can turn natural-language descriptions into correct optimization models and code.
note.zh: 引入规范化中间表示，让大模型能把自然语言描述转换成正确的优化模型与求解代码。

title.en: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents
title.zh: InfiAgent: An Infinite-Horizon Framework for General-Purpose Autonomous Agents

note.en: InfiAgent, her lab's agent framework, extended to infinite-horizon tasks where context growth and error accumulation normally break agents.
note.zh: 她实验室 InfiAgent 框架的无限时域版本，针对长任务中上下文膨胀与误差累积的问题。

title.en: InfiMed-ORBIT: Aligning LLMs on Open-Ended Complex Tasks via Rubric-Based Incremental Training
title.zh: InfiMed-ORBIT: Aligning LLMs on Open-Ended Complex Tasks via Rubric-Based Incremental Training

note.en: Aligns medical LLMs on open-ended tasks with rubric-based incremental RL, part of her InfiMed medical model line.
note.zh: 用基于评分细则的增量式强化学习对齐医疗大模型，属于她的 InfiMed 医疗模型系列。

title.en: Model Merging Scaling Laws in Large Language Models
title.zh: Model Merging Scaling Laws in Large Language Models

note.en: Derives empirical scaling laws for model merging, giving a quantitative rule for the returns of adding more experts.
note.zh: 给出模型合并的经验缩放律，量化了增加专家模型所带来的收益。

title.en: A Comprehensive FP8 Training Recipe for Reasoning-Enhanced Language Models
title.zh: A Comprehensive FP8 Training Recipe for Reasoning-Enhanced Language Models

note.en: A full FP8 training recipe for reasoning-oriented LLMs, aimed at cutting training cost.
note.zh: 面向推理增强型大模型的完整 FP8 训练方案，目标是降低训练成本。

title.en: InfiAgent: Self-Evolving Pyramid Agent Framework for Infinite Scenarios
title.zh: InfiAgent: Self-Evolving Pyramid Agent Framework for Infinite Scenarios

note.en: The earlier InfiAgent release: a self-evolving pyramid-structured agent framework for open-ended scenarios.
note.zh: InfiAgent 的早期版本：面向开放场景的自演化金字塔式智能体框架。

title.en: InfiMed-Foundation: Pioneering Advanced Multimodal Medical Models with Compute-Efficient Pre-Training and Multi-Stage Fine-Tuning
title.zh: InfiMed-Foundation: Pioneering Advanced Multimodal Medical Models with Compute-Efficient Pre-Training and Multi-Stage Fine-Tuning

note.en: InfiMed-Foundation, a compute-efficient multimodal medical foundation model from her group.
note.zh: InfiMed-Foundation：她团队推出的计算高效多模态医疗基础模型。

title.en: PTQTP: Post-Training Quantization to Trit-Planes for Large Language Models
title.zh: PTQTP: Post-Training Quantization to Trit-Planes for Large Language Models

note.en: Post-training quantization of LLMs to ternary trit-planes, pushing bit-width to an extreme.
note.zh: 将大模型训练后量化压缩到三值位平面，把比特宽度推向极限。

title.en: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization
title.zh: InfiGUI-G1: Advancing GUI Grounding with Adaptive Exploration Policy Optimization

note.en: InfiGUI-G1 improves GUI grounding for vision-based computer-use agents via an adaptive exploration policy.
note.zh: InfiGUI-G1 用自适应探索策略优化提升视觉 GUI 智能体的元素定位能力。

title.en: InfiAlign: A Scalable and Sample-Efficient Framework for Aligning LLMs to Enhance Reasoning Capabilities
title.zh: InfiAlign: A Scalable and Sample-Efficient Framework for Aligning LLMs to Enhance Reasoning Capabilities

note.en: InfiAlign, a sample-efficient post-training alignment framework for improving LLM reasoning.
note.zh: InfiAlign：一套样本高效的后训练对齐框架，用于提升大模型推理能力。

title.en: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use
title.zh: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use

note.en: A large multi-institution survey of MLLM-based OS/GUI agents, which she co-authored.
note.zh: 她参与合著的多机构综述，系统梳理了基于多模态大模型的操作系统与 GUI 智能体。

title.en: SwingArena: Competitive Programming Arena for Long-context GitHub Issue Solving
title.zh: SwingArena: Competitive Programming Arena for Long-context GitHub Issue Solving

note.en: SwingArena, an evaluation arena where LLMs compete on long-context real GitHub issue solving.
note.zh: SwingArena：让大模型在真实 GitHub issue 长上下文任务上竞争的评测平台。

title.en: InfiMed: Low-Resource Medical MLLMs with Advancing Understanding and Reasoning
title.zh: InfiMed: Low-Resource Medical MLLMs with Advancing Understanding and Reasoning

note.en: InfiMed, the first of her group's low-resource medical multimodal LLMs.
note.zh: InfiMed：她团队低资源医疗多模态大模型系列的第一篇工作。

title.en: Appointed Vobile Group Professor in Generative Artificial Intelligence
title.zh: 获聘生成式人工智能 Vobile 集团冠名教授

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：如果未来所有数据被几家公司掌握是极其恐怖的
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：如果未来所有数据被几家公司掌握是极其恐怖的

body.en: Yang warned that concentrating all data in the hands of a few companies would be dangerous, arguing for broader data access as AI training grows more data-dependent.
body.zh: 杨红霞警告称，如果未来所有数据都被少数几家公司掌握将是极其危险的，主张在AI训练日益依赖数据的背景下应保持更广泛的数据获取渠道。

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：为什么“AI大力出奇迹”逐渐失效？因为公开数据快爬完了
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：为什么“AI大力出奇迹”逐渐失效？因为公开数据快爬完了

body.en: Yang argued that brute-force scaling of AI is losing effectiveness because public training data is running out.
body.zh: 杨红霞认为，"大力出奇迹"式的AI暴力扩展正逐渐失效，原因是公开可用的训练数据即将枯竭。

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：如果未来所有数据被几家公司掌握是极其恐怖的
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：如果未来所有数据被几家公司掌握是极其恐怖的

body.en: Yang warned that data being controlled by only a handful of companies would be an extremely dangerous outcome for AI's future.
body.zh: 杨红霞警告称，如果未来所有数据都被少数几家公司掌控，将是极其可怕的局面。

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞 ：为什么“AI大力出奇迹”逐渐失效？因为公开数据快爬完了
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞 ：为什么“AI大力出奇迹”逐渐失效？因为公开数据快爬完了

body.en: Yang argued that the "scale is all you need" approach is losing steam because public training data is running out.
body.zh: 杨红霞指出，"大力出奇迹"式的规模化路线正逐渐失效，原因是公开可用的训练数据即将耗尽。

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3

body.en: Yang argued domain-specific models need only tens of billions of parameters, citing a hospital-specific model that outperforms Gemini-3 in accuracy on the mainland.
body.zh: 杨红霞认为领域模型只需几百亿参数即可，并举例称内地一款医院专用模型的准确率超过了Gemini-3。

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞谈“AI大力出奇迹”失效原因
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞谈“AI大力出奇迹”失效原因

body.en: Hongxia Yang discussed why 'brute-force' compute scaling is losing effectiveness in AI development.
body.zh: 杨红霞谈到「AI大力出奇迹」（暴力堆算力）为何正在失效。

title.en: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3
title.zh: 香港AI专家杨红霞：领域模型几百亿参数就够，内地医院专用模型准确率远超Gemini-3

body.en: Yang argued domain-specific models don't need huge parameter counts, citing a mainland hospital model that outperforms Gemini-3 in accuracy on medical tasks.
body.zh: 杨红霞表示垂直领域模型无需庞大参数量即可胜任，并举例内地一家医院的专用模型在准确率上已超过Gemini-3。

title.en: 杨红霞：领域模型只需几百亿参数，130亿参数鼻咽癌模型准确率超95% 远超Gemini-3
title.zh: 杨红霞：领域模型只需几百亿参数，130亿参数鼻咽癌模型准确率超95% 远超Gemini-3

body.en: Yang said a domain-specific model with only about 13B parameters beat Gemini-3 on nasopharyngeal-cancer diagnosis accuracy (over 95%), arguing domain models don't need hundreds of billions of parameters.
body.zh: 杨红霞表示，仅130亿参数的领域模型在鼻咽癌诊断准确率上超过95%，超过Gemini-3，说明领域模型并不需要千亿级参数规模。

title.en: 杨红霞教授：大模型将从中心化走向去中心化，领域模型可超越全球最强通用模型
title.zh: 杨红霞教授：大模型将从中心化走向去中心化，领域模型可超越全球最强通用模型

body.en: She publicly argued that large models will shift from centralized to decentralized and that domain-specific models can outperform the strongest general models — the thesis behind her PolyU and InfiX work.
body.zh: 她公开提出大模型将从中心化走向去中心化、领域模型可以超越最强通用模型，这也是她在理大及 InfiX 系列工作的核心主张。
